question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_paid
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    ORDER BY total_paid DESC
    LIMIT 10
  )
),
monthly_payments AS (
  SELECT t.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name,
         date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) as payment_month,
         SUM(p.amount) as monthly_total
  FROM payment p
  JOIN top10 t ON p.customer_id = t.customer_id
  JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY t.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
mom_changes AS (
  SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, payment_month, monthly_total,
         monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as mom_change
  FROM monthly_payments
)
SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, 
       payment_month as month, 
       ROUND(mom_change, 2) as max_mom_change
FROM mom_changes
WHERE mom_change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(mom_change) DESC
LIMIT 1
